name: 51360 · Spirit Lake, IA
findings: ZIP 51360 (Spirit Lake) has 46 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 51360 (Spirit Lake) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 51360 (Spirit Lake) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 53% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.
